Sodium reacts with chlorine to form sodium chloride.
Which statements describe what happens to the sodium atoms in this reaction?
1
Sodium atoms form positive ions.
2
Sodium atoms form negative ions.
3
Sodium atoms gain electrons.
4
Sodium atoms lose electrons.
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
